description:
Fluffernutter is one of those combos you either love or hate....... I LOVE it. What better way to incorporate two great flavours than to make Jeni's Fluffernutter Pie ice cream. 

Jeni's fluffernutter pie ice cream is a duo tub of salty peanut butter ice cream and vanilla marshmallow ice cream, both mixed in with a salty oat pie crust. I name for the pie crust is open to interpretation though 😉

What you'll need.....

Peanut Butter Ice Cream:
300ml Milk (1.8% fat)
150ml Cream (49% fat)
110g Sugar
1g Stabiliser (not required) (Locust Bean Gum, Fatty Acids, Guar Gum, Sodium Alginate, Agar Agar)
1/2 tsp Kosher salt
65g Peanut butter (Skippy smooth)

Marshmallow Ice Cream:
300ml Milk (1.8% fat)
200ml Cream (49% fat)
75g Sugar
3 x large marshmallows (total 75g) (must contain gelatin and around 30-35g sugar)

Pie Crust:
80g Oats (quick cook)
40g All-purpose flour (plain flour)
80g Dark brown sugar
0.5 tsp Salt
75g Butter

The above will give you around 1.3L of finished ice cream complete with add ins. The salty pie crsut really cuts through the sweet ice cream and is a perfect contrast.
